fields.name: displayDisclaimer
fields.fieldText:
DISCLAIMER

This estimator is used best during early-stage opportunities and is for directional use only.

The calculator will provide a directionally accurate cost of service savings across different Geography and Channel combinations. A pricing model from Finance is always required for any formal client-facing product/service proposal.

Results from this estimator shoudl guide strategic discussions and are for directional purposes/guidance only.
